signal: Prove launched its unified Identity Platform, a Verified Agent solution for agentic commerce, and a Global Identity Graph, after raising $40M led by MassMutual and Capital One Ventures.

email.body1:
Doug, saw Prove launched its unified Identity Platform and Verified Agent solution for agentic commerce.

A platform expansion like that usually opens more accounts than the team can cover before the motion settles, and that is where deals stall. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a signal play for Prove off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Doug, quick follow-up for Prove.

With the Identity Platform and Global Identity Graph widening the story, the pipeline target probably grew faster than the team can. Most sales leaders cannot say exactly how many meetings they need to hit the new number, so the gap shows up late and the quarter becomes a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Prove needs to close that gap this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Doug, last bit of proof for Prove.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Prove's reply rate likely compares to peer identity and fintech teams. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Doug, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount is not a priority this quarter, no problem at all. I know a platform launch keeps a sales calendar packed.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to Prove's motion? I will tailor it to you either way.
